BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   D. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   D. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   D. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

5. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   D. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   B. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

13. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

16. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Money as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS

17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Global Influence in Business 3.1 Public and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
